item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 18/Aug/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The tropical cyclone over the northern part of the South China Sea will move across Beibu Wan today. Meanwhile, under the combined effect of the ridge of high pressure over southeastern China and the tropical cyclone, it will be windy with heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea. With the tropical cyclone moving into the inland areas and weakening, showers will ease off gradually over the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. An anticyclone aloft is expected to strengthen slightly in the latter part of this week, the weather will improve over the coast of southern China. It will be very hot during the day.

Date/Month: 18/08 (Monday)
Wind: East to southeast force 5, force 6 offshore and on high ground at first. Force 4 later.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional showers and squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times. Seas will be rough with swells.
Temp range: 25 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
